name: Caddisfly larvae & aquatic moth larvae
description: Case- and net-building aquatic larvae. Functional group pooling the source's seven caddisfly taxa (Polycentropus, Molanna, Banksiola, Agrypnia, Limnephilus, Mystacides, Oecetis) with one aquatic moth larva (a Parapoynx relative); most scrape algae and detritus, while Polycentropus is a net-spinning predator.
